-- REACTOR MESH CONTROLLER R1 / server-side motion for reviewed GLBs.
-- Drives two genuine side hatches, their telescoping pistons and rigid emitters
-- from CORE_PROTOCOL_Server's authoritative mode attributes. No input is
-- simulated; the original player-operated controls and safety logic remain.
-- The other four radial mounting bays and final room roof/floor are separate
-- modeling tasks. This controller does not claim they are present already.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local SS=game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
local WS=game:GetService("Workspace")
local scene=WS:WaitForChild("REACTOR_MESH_ASSEMBLY",30)
if not scene or not scene:IsA("Model") then
 warn("[MESH] No reviewed reactor assembly installed; leaving R5 unchanged")
 return
end
local moving=scene:WaitForChild("MOVING",8)
local fixed=scene:WaitForChild("STATIC",8)
if not moving or not fixed then warn("[MESH] Assembly incomplete");return end
local core=fixed:FindFirstChild("REACTOR_CORE_MANYETIK_01")
if not core or not core:IsA("Model") then warn("[MESH] Core missing");return end
local world=WS:WaitForChild("CORE_PROTOCOL_V2_WORLD",60)
if not world then warn("[MESH] R5 room did not start; leaving COLD static geometry");return end
-- R5's control room, window, physical controls, room and game systems stay.
-- Retire ONLY its obsolete Part-based projector/core VISUAL folder at runtime.
-- R5 still owns those Part references safely, but they are off-world.
local old=world:FindFirstChild("03_STAR_REACTOR")
if old then old.Parent=SS end

local ORIGIN=scene:GetAttribute("Origin") or Vector3.new(0,26.5,0)
local SIDES={LEFT=1,RIGHT=-1}
local rigs={}
local function must(parent,name)
 local m=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
 if not m or not m:IsA("Model") then error("[MESH] Required Model missing: "..name) end
 return m
end
local function opticOf(model)
 local optic=model:FindFirstChild("OPTIC__cyan",true)
 if not optic or not optic:IsA("MeshPart") then
  error("[MESH] Approved emitter has no optic mesh: "..model.Name)
 end
 return optic
end
for side,axis in SIDES do
 local suffix="_"..side
 local hatch=must(moving,"REACTOR_WALL_HATCH_THROUGH_01"..suffix)
 local piston=must(moving,"REACTOR_PISTON_GUIDE_01"..suffix)
 local emitter=must(moving,"REACTOR_EMITTER_REV03"..suffix)
 local rig={axis=axis,hatch=hatch,piston=piston,emitter=emitter,
            optical=opticOf(emitter),stages={},doors={}}
 rig.emitterHome=emitter:GetPivot() -- retracted rigid-body home
 for _,leaf in {"LEAF_LEFT","LEAF_RIGHT"} do
  local group=must(hatch,leaf)
  rig.doors[leaf]={model=group,home=group:GetPivot()}
 end
 for _,part in {"STAGE1","STAGE2","STAGE3","PUSHER"} do
  local group=must(piston,part)
  rig.stages[part]={model=group,home=group:GetPivot()}
 end
 rigs[side]=rig
end
local anchor=Instance.new("Part")
anchor.Name="REACTOR_EFFECT_ATTACHMENTS_NOT_GEOMETRY"
anchor.Size=Vector3.new(.12,.12,.12)
anchor.CFrame=CFrame.new(ORIGIN)
anchor.Transparency=1;anchor.Anchored=true
anchor.CanCollide=false;anchor.CanTouch=false;anchor.CanQuery=false
anchor.CastShadow=false;anchor.Parent=scene
local center=Instance.new("Attachment")
center.Name="PHOTON_CENTER";center.Parent=anchor
local coreLamp=Instance.new("PointLight")
coreLamp.Name="REACTOR_MESH_STATE_LIGHT";coreLamp.Brightness=0
coreLamp.Range=35;coreLamp.Shadows=true
coreLamp.Color=Color3.fromRGB(196,213,255);coreLamp.Parent=anchor
local function particle(name,tex,rate,color,startsize,endsize)
 local p=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
 p.Name=name;p.Texture=tex;p.Enabled=false;p.Rate=rate
 p.Color=ColorSequence.new(color)
 p.LightEmission=.7;p.Speed=NumberRange.new(1.5,4.2)
 p.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.18,.72)
 p.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(160,160)
 p.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,startsize),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.45,endsize),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
 p.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.21),
   NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.78,.58),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
 return p
end
local plasma=particle("REACTOR_DYNAMIC_ION_SPARKS",
 "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",0,
 Color3.fromRGB(151,120,255),.5,1.7)
plasma.Parent=center
local vapor=particle("REACTOR_DYNAMIC_PLASMA_VAPOR",
 "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",0,
 Color3.fromRGB(87,73,178),1.3,4.4)
vapor.LightEmission=.22;vapor.Speed=NumberRange.new(.35,1.7)
vapor.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,2.5);vapor.Parent=center
local beams={}
for side,rig in SIDES do
 local optic=rigs[side].optical
 local tip=Instance.new("Attachment")
 tip.Name="ION_NOZZLE_SIDEBEAM";tip.Parent=optic
 local list={}
 for i,spec in {{"AZURE",.62,Color3.fromRGB(47,138,255)},
               {"WHITE",.23,Color3.fromRGB(240,241,255)}} do
  local b=Instance.new("Beam")
  b.Name="REACTOR_"..side.."_"..spec[1]
  b.Attachment0=center;b.Attachment1=tip
  b.FaceCamera=true;b.Segments=14
  b.Width0=spec[2];b.Width1=spec[2]*.65
  b.Color=ColorSequence.new(spec[3]);b.LightEmission=1
  b.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(1);b.Enabled=false
  b.Parent=anchor;list[i]=b
 end
 beams[side]=list
 local l=Instance.new("PointLight")
 l.Name="UNLIT_EMITTER_OPTIC";l.Color=Color3.fromRGB(67,185,255)
 l.Brightness=0;l.Range=12;l.Parent=optic
 rigs[side].light=l
 local smoke=particle("MELTDOWN_NOZZLE_LEAK",
   "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",0,
   Color3.fromRGB(76,93,124),.55,2.2)
 smoke.Speed=NumberRange.new(1,3);smoke.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.6,1.6)
 smoke.LightEmission=0;smoke.Parent=tip
 rigs[side].leak=smoke
end
local coreParts={}
for _,p in core:GetDescendants() do
 if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
  local t=p:GetAttribute("GLB_VisibleTransparency")
  coreParts[#coreParts+1]={p=p,visible=typeof(t)=="number" and t or 0}
  p.Transparency=1;p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 end
end
local gate,stroke,energy=0,0,0
local modeLast=nil
local function moveToward(value,target,amount)
 if value<target then return math.min(target,value+amount) end
 return math.max(target,value-amount)
end
local function ease(x)
 x=math.clamp(x,0,1)
 return x*x*(3-2*x)
end
local function poseHardware(openFrac,pistonFrac)
 local g=ease(openFrac);local p=ease(pistonFrac)
 for side,rig in rigs do
  local axis=rig.axis
  -- Approved local Y slides in opposite directions. Y-depth was converted
  -- to world Z during GLB preparation; mirror the right module as approved.
  rig.doors.LEAF_LEFT.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,0,axis*5.85*g)*
    rig.doors.LEAF_LEFT.home)
  rig.doors.LEAF_RIGHT.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,0,-axis*5.85*g)*
    rig.doors.LEAF_RIGHT.home)
  rig.stages.STAGE1.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(axis*6.6*p,0,0)*rig.stages.STAGE1.home)
  rig.stages.STAGE2.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(axis*13.2*p,0,0)*rig.stages.STAGE2.home)
  rig.stages.STAGE3.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(axis*19.8*p,0,0)*rig.stages.STAGE3.home)
  rig.stages.PUSHER.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(axis*19.8*p,0,0)*rig.stages.PUSHER.home)
  -- Emitter itself is rigid: NO scaling/stretching of any emitter mesh.
  rig.emitter:PivotTo(CFrame.new(axis*19.8*p,0,0)*rig.emitterHome)
 end
end
local running={STARTUP=true,ONLINE=true,WARNING=true,MELTDOWN=true,
               FREEZEDOWN=true,AFTERMATH=true}
local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(rawDt)
 elapsed+=math.clamp(rawDt,0,.20)
 if elapsed<.08 then return end
 local dt=elapsed;elapsed=0
 local mode=world:GetAttribute("ReactorMode") or "COLD"
 local startupAge=world:GetAttribute("ReactorStartupAge") or 0
 local meltdownAge=world:GetAttribute("ReactorMeltdownAge") or 0
 local sourcePresent=world:GetAttribute("ReactorMeshSignal") == 1
 if not sourcePresent then mode="COLD" end -- fail-safe: no active beams
 if mode~=modeLast then
  modeLast=mode
  scene:SetAttribute("MotionStatus",mode)
  print("[MESH] state=",mode,"; R5 source=",sourcePresent)
 end
 local openWanted=running[mode] == true
 if openWanted then
  gate=moveToward(gate,1,dt/1.55)
  if gate>=.999 then stroke=moveToward(stroke,1,dt/4.0) end
 else
  energy=moveToward(energy,0,dt/1.10)
  if energy<=.02 then stroke=moveToward(stroke,0,dt/4.0) end
  if stroke<=.003 then gate=moveToward(gate,0,dt/1.55) end
 end
 local doIgnite=openWanted and mode~="AFTERMATH"
   and mode~="STARTUP" or mode=="STARTUP" and startupAge>=29
 local energized=doIgnite and gate>=.999 and stroke>=.999
 energy=moveToward(energy,energized and 1 or 0,dt/2.4)
 poseHardware(gate,stroke)
 local e=ease(energy)
 for side,rig in rigs do
  local ready=(mode~="STARTUP") or
    startupAge>=(side=="LEFT" and 15 or 18)
  local glow=ready and stroke>=.999 and e or 0
  if mode=="STARTUP" and startupAge<29 then
   glow=ready and stroke>=.999 and .38 or 0
  end
  if mode=="AFTERMATH" then glow=0 end
  rig.optical.Material=glow>.02 and Enum.Material.Neon
    or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
  rig.light.Brightness=glow*1.9
  local destroyed=mode=="MELTDOWN" and meltdownAge>=
    (side=="LEFT" and 95 or 215)
  if destroyed then
   rig.optical.Color=Color3.fromRGB(238,79,40)
   rig.light.Color=Color3.fromRGB(254,83,37)
   rig.light.Brightness=.25+(math.sin(os.clock()*12)>0 and .75 or 0)
   rig.leak.Enabled=true;rig.leak.Rate=side=="LEFT" and 26 or 14
  else
   rig.optical.Color=glow>.02 and Color3.fromRGB(48,190,251)
     or Color3.fromRGB(12,76,127)
   rig.light.Color=Color3.fromRGB(67,185,255)
   rig.leak.Enabled=false
  end
  for _,b in beams[side] do
   b.Enabled=glow>.025 and not destroyed
   b.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(1-glow*.84,.12,1))
  end
 end
 local strength=mode=="AFTERMATH" and 0 or e
 for _,info in coreParts do
  local p=info.p
  p.Transparency=1-strength*(1-info.visible)*.78
  if p.Name=="CENTER__WHITE_CORE" then
   p.Material=strength>.035 and Enum.Material.Neon
     or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
   p.Transparency=1-strength*.78
  end
 end
 coreLamp.Brightness=mode=="MELTDOWN" and
   math.min(3.1,1.6+meltdownAge/215)*e or e*1.85
 coreLamp.Color=mode=="MELTDOWN" and meltdownAge>240
   and Color3.fromRGB(255,122,161) or Color3.fromRGB(196,213,255)
 plasma.Enabled=e>.02;plasma.Rate=math.floor(10+50*e)
 vapor.Enabled=e>.04;vapor.Rate=math.floor(5+25*e)
 if mode=="COLD" then
  coreLamp.Brightness=0;plasma.Enabled=false;vapor.Enabled=false
 end
end)
print("[MESH] Installed seven reviewed GLBs: two side mechanisms, COLD-off core VFX."
 .." No new mouse inputs, no claim about unapproved audio or future four bays.")
